Description (Wikipedia)
The harlequin poison frog, also known as harlequin poison-dart frog (Oophaga histrionica), is a species of poison dart frog endemic to the Chocó region of western Colombia.The frog is normally found on the ground of tropical rain forests, among fallen limbs or leaf litter.
The harlequin poison frog has a variety of color morphs, which differ from one valley to the next in its native range.The base color is a bright orange, with a webbing of black over the entire body.Of the color morphs, the base color may be of clear to dull orange, yellow, red, white, or blue.The web pattern varies from small lines to big lines or speckled, incomplete lines, or a completely black frog with just a few spots.

Description (Wikipedia)
Adelphobates galactonotus (splash-backed poison frog or splashback poison frog) is a species of poison dart frog.
It is endemic to the rainforest of the southern Amazon Basin in Brazil. Its natural habitats are tropical moist lowland forests. The eggs are laid on the ground, but the tadpoles are carried to temporary pools. Though it remains widespread and locally common, it is threatened by habitat loss and has already disappeared from some localities due to deforestation and flooding caused by dams. The species is relatively common in captivity and regularly bred, but the wild populations are still at risk from illegal collection.

description_text:
This device is intended for Oftalmology MD practisioners. It will allow them to lower costs in pricey expendables giving them also access to a unique tool that can be adjusted to meet very specific and unusual needs.
Originally designed for oftalmologic urgency eye washing, the device evolved into a precision adapter for eye scan exploration probes. About the design:
The device has a stop that situates the probe's tip at the right distance from the corneal surface. An M3 nylon bolt secures the probe and its perpendicularity is achieved by a double set of internal guide rings.
A Luer lock connector  included in the design (set in the base for easy unsupported 3D printing) will fit standard tubing for proper fluid flow, meanwhile, a circular array of grooves prevents the formation of air bubbles in the optical chamber
The design is guaranteed and will be custom fit to any biometer and tweaked by us to accomodate any of the customer's special needs. Please contact us for more information.
So far, different models of the design have been used with biometers manufactured by the following brands: Alcon OcuScan - Tomey

description_text:
The example scene on the signature image is not included in the files!
The collection contains 40 different lightnings - 20 Cloud to Air and 20 Cloud to Ground.
$361 Bundle savings! ($19 per model if bought separately)
These realistic Lightning 3D models are crafted to blend seamlessly in any kind of background environment and render very fast.
The mesh is optimized for low polycount and can also be used in games.
Total Polygons:469,291
Total Vertices:471,397
The Lightning geometry is made in real world scale ~ 8km height (which is the average height of Lightnings), but can be scaled up or down to fit your needs and will still look good in renders.Scene units - m (meters).
This is a V-Ray version.If you are using other renderer you will be able to use the geometry, but will have to make/use your own materials.
Every branch can be easily selected (by Element) in case you want to animate different illumination and/or timings per branch (as it happens in real world) for some spectacular slow motion animations.
All elements are UVW Unwrapped without overlapping just in case you need to use textures. Current one uses Vertex Color (which can be baked to texture if needed) and is embedded in the exported FBX format too (can be baked in Substance Designer, etc.).
Feel free to adjust the brightness of the light materials to best match your scene and camera settings. They are properly named and easy to set, separated by branch size.
The glow of the main bolt is made via V-Ray Lens effects Bloom + Glare (which is set up in the scene) and can be turned off if you want to add your own effects in post.
Rendered on black background the lightning will be perfect to blend in your image via 'Screen' or 'Lighten' mode in PhotoShop, AffiniPhoto, etc.
The geometry can also be used as a light source when merged in your scene.
Make sure to check out a related V-Ray rendering tip included with this product as .jpg and .txt files.
Can be easily imported via drag and drop - there are no background objects, cameras and additional lights in the scene.
You can see more renders and wireframes on the individual product pages if you need to.
Compatible with 3dsMax 2010 and up.
Exported versions in 3DS, FBX and OBJ formats (no materials).
Please have in mind, that depending on the software you use, the exported formats may not look exactly how you see them in the preview images. In some cases the mesh may appear triangulated and you may need to manually reassign materials/textures .
If you feel like it, please use hashtag #lightning3d when you post online an image that uses this model, it will be fun for me to have a look.
Enjoy!

description_text:
This is a 'Ship of the line' class galleon ship that takes much inspiration from the Norwegian Lion ship that Denmark-Norway sailed throughout the early 17th centuary.The Norwegian Lion was 14 meters (45,9 feet) wide at the widest hull and 51,5 meters (168,9 feet) long, not including the bowsprit. It had 70 canons, wheras 26 were 24-pounders, 26 were 18-pounders, and 18 were 8-pounders. The ship would crew 542 men at full operation.The ship also resembles similar ships of the time such as the VOC replica, HMS Leopard or the Swedish 'Gotheborg'. 
This 3D model is currently intended for exterior shots, or deck shots in certain situations.
Features:

  - Real world scale

  - Full seemingly acurate sail rigging. (How exacly these sails were rigged in the 17th century is not well documented)

  - Detailing assets such as Lanterns, bells, and bundles of rope.

  - PBR Assets

  - Two sets of sails (flat, and with thickness. Thickness used for SSS, flat used for simulations)

  - Geometry detailed down to about 10 cm (4 inches), though some pieces are more detailed, others maybe bit less.

  - No extensive use of heavy textures, uses mostly 2k textures with smaller pieces using 512 or 1024 textures.

  - No in-software material trickery (math or texture blend etc), only textures directly connected in material. (makes it less time-consuming to reach similar results in different softwares)

  - Made with optimization in mind. The native Maya file makes extensive use of instanced geometry (The blender file too, but at less extent) and referenced assets.

Files:
This sale is delivered as a single .zip file using custom file structure.  That is why the _3D Model formats_ overview in the sidebar may seem inacurate. 

  - Native Maya project

  - 3Ds Max project

  - Blender project

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - Textures in tidy hierarchy

  - 
Around 3,7 milion triangles in the total project, were;

  - Cannons amount for around 1,8 milion triangles.

  - Ropes and rigging amount for around 1,4 milion triangles.

Includes the following assets, that can be purchased seperatley:

  - 8 pound canon ( https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/various/various-models/8-pound-naval-cannon )

  - 18 pound canon  ( https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/various/various-models/18-pound-naval-cannon )

Future plans:
As this product sells further updates may be given to it. Here are some examples:

  - Folded / Idle sails option.

  - Captain quarter interior stage 1 (This will add some interior to the captain quarters, allowing for the windows at the back of the ship to be see-through, thus show some interior)

  - Canon-doors stage 2 (this will add more detail to the canon-doors and frame)

  - Forcastle (upper front of ship) interior update. (This will make the ship look more finnished in certain close shots, where the inside of the forcastle is visible through the waist deck entrance)

  -  'Upperdeck' (upmost deck that is not weatherdeck) interior. (This will be the first major step towards making the ships complete interior)

  - Captain quarter interior stage 2 (This will add finishing touch to the interior of the captain quarters, allowing for interior shots)

description_text:
An early cosmological model of our solar system, in full 3d-printed detail. From Kepler's book _Mysterium Cosmographicum_, 1596. Kepler thought that the planets orbited the Earth, each within an orbit set on a regular polyhedron. He was mightily wrong, but his design is iconic and inspiring.  
All regular polyhedra are represented, in this order from the inside out: octahedron, icosahedron, dodecahedron, tetrahedron, cube. I also included the text from the page of Kepler's book, Tabvla III Orbivm Planetarvm and Johannes Kepler on the opposite side of the base.  
Try coloring it! The material is porous and you can submerge it into tea, wine, etc to give it color.  
Notes on Kepler's work and this planetary model:  
_In the XVI century, the German astronomer Johannes Kepler (1571-1630) tried to find a relation among the five regular platonic solids and the six planets known in his time: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn. Kepler thought the two numbers were connected: the reason there were only six planets was because there were only five regular solids.  
In 1596, in his work Mysterium Cosmographicum, Kepler established a model of the solar system where the five platonic solids were inserted one inside another, separated by a series of inscribed spheres. He realized that the ratios among the planets orbits' radii could match the ratios among the spheres' radii. His model, however, was not supported by the experimental data from the astronomers Tycho Brahe (Danish, 1546-1601) and Nicolau Copernicus (Polish, 1473-1543). Indeed, his model was entirely disapproved by posterior discoveries of the planets Uranus and Neptune: there are no additional platonic solids that determine their distances to the Sun. However, from his research, new solids were discovered (that, nowadays, are named after him), the perception that the orbits of the planets are not circles but ellipses, and the three laws of the planetary motion._

These realistic Lightning 3D models are crafted to blend seamlessly in any kind of background environment and render very fast.
The mesh is optimized for low polycount and can also be used in games.
Total Polygons:157,406

The Lightning geometry is made in real world scale ~ 8km height (which is the average height of this type of Cloud to Ground Lightning), but can be scaled up or down to fit your needs and will still look good in renders.Scene units - m (meters).
This is a V-Ray version.If you are using other renderer you will be able to use the geometry, but will have to make/use your own materials.
Every branch can be easily selected (by Element) in case you want to animate different illumination and/or timings per branch (as it happens in real world) for some spectacular slow motion animations.
All elements are UVW Unwrapped without overlapping just in case you need to use textures. Current one uses Vertex Color (which can be baked to texture if needed) and is embedded in the exported FBX format too (can be baked in Substance Designer, etc.).
Feel free to adjust the brightness of the light materials to best match your scene and camera settings. They are properly named and easy to set, separated by branch size.
The glow of the main bolt is made via V-Ray Lens effects Bloom + Glare (which is set up in the scene) and can be turned off if you want to add your own effects in post.
Rendered on black background the lightning will be perfect to blend in your image via 'Screen' or 'Lighten' mode in PhotoShop, AffiniPhoto, etc.
The geometry can also be used as a light source when merged in your scene. You can adjust only the main bolt strength as it is the brightest and most influential.
Make sure to check out a related V-Ray rendering tip included with this product as .jpg and .txt files.
You can see more renders and wireframes on the individual product pages if you need to.
Can be easily imported via drag and drop - there are no background objects, cameras and additional lights in the scene.
Compatible with 3dsMax 2010 and up.
Exported versions in 3DS, FBX and OBJ formats (no materials).
Please have in mind, that depending on the software you use, the exported formats may not look exactly how you see them in the preview images. In some cases the mesh may appear triangulated and you may need to manually reassign materials/textures .
If you feel like it, please use hashtag #lightning3d when you post online an image that uses this model, it will be fun for me to see.
Enjoy!

3D Printed Palatal Expansion Model from Patient DICOM Data
This model was created directly from segmented DICOM imaging of a young patient requiring palatal expansion. By transforming radiographic data into a physical 3D print, we’re able to precisely replicate the patient’s internal anatomy, not just the external form.
Unlike traditional dental typodonts, this model demonstrates the true bone structure, midpalatal suture, and surrounding anatomy as captured in the original scan. The level of internal detail provides clinicians and students with a more accurate understanding of how palatal expansion impacts skeletal and dental structures in growing patients.
Because the model is derived from real patient data, it highlights variations in anatomy that are critical for diagnosis, treatment planning, and training. This allows orthodontic teams to visualize and practice procedures on a physical replica before applying them clinically, enhancing both safety and educational value.

overview:
This asset bundle features highly detailed 3D models of all major celestial bodies in the Solar System, combining optimized icosahedral meshes with 16K physically accurate equirectangular textures seamlessly mapped without polar distortion. Designed for film, games, VR, AR, and fulldome environments, these assets are production ready out of the box with embedded materials and advanced atmospheric and emissive shaders. The pack includes Earth, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn with rings, Uranus with rings, and Neptune.
Scientific Background
This collection offers a unified scientifically informed representation of the Solar System based on real mission data from NASA and ESA. Each planet and moon has been carefully reconstructed using accurate measurements and high resolution imagery, offering consistent artistic direction and technical quality across the entire set. While features like Saturn’s ring system, Venus’s cloud layers, or the layered atmospheres of gas giants are faithfully represented, the true strength of this bundle lies in its coherence and professional grade readiness for any production environment.
Technical Features

  - 16384 × 8192 px textures: Color, Roughness, Normal, Displacement (varies by object)

  - Multi layered cloud textures for Earth, Mars, and Venus

  - Emission maps and glow shaders for the Sun

  - Ring systems for Saturn and Uranus with dedicated color, opacity, and roughness maps

  - Seamless icosahedral mesh topology without poles or seams

  - Volumetric atmospheres for ray traced rendering

  - Shader Graph based atmospheric solution for Unity URP

  - Calibrated physically based materials for high fidelity rendering

Included Formats

  - Blender 4.5 (.blend) with Cycles and Eevee materials, volumetric effects, and embedded 16K JPG textures

  - 3ds Max 2022 with V Ray (zip) with embedded materials and 16K JPG textures

  - Unity 2022 URP (.unitypackage) with custom shaders and embedded 16K JPG textures 

  - Uncompressed 16K PNG texture sets for maximum visual fidelity  To be included during the first two weeks of August 2025

Key Benefits

  - Complete and visually consistent Solar System model library

  - Production ready with no need to assign materials or configure shaders

  - Ideal for VFX, VR, AR, scientific visualization, planetariums, matte painting, and cinematic space scenes

  -  Free lifetime updates including future improvements and format extensions

Current Version: 5.10
Created for professionals who need reliable assets with minimal setup time.

Exoskeleton linked to an animated mannequin. Full motion freedom reconfigurable actuator frame based on tetrahedrally configured, motorised wormdrive cylinders.  A single-wire multispectral power/databus interconnects the motors. Turbojet power backpack, refuelable on-the-go. Full circular traction feedback sensors assumed to be mounted in the limb offloading bands. Engineered for maximum mobility in combination with maximum bodily autoadaptation and minimum space requirements.
Key skeletal parts are parented to key bones in a character. The model is heavily instanced from reference details. Elements are rigged with motion controllers, Skin, Skin Wrap.Note: this model uses advanced rigging features of Max and is not easily convertible to 3D engines like Unity nor to simple FBX-like rigging (would need replication of a Max-like alignment controller)

Mannequin is mapped procedurally and fully rigged.Layered PSDs included for customisation of the textures.This model has a complex rigging setup and is not advisable for inexperienced Max users.
Concept and design by the artist.3D Studio Max 9 file.

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model Collection (36 models)
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using these models as much as I had making them.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
File：All file are filed in the same directory, and there is no case of losing textures. Please double click .mb file to open, or open / import in the file menu in the Maya window. Do not drag .mb file to maya interface. Files include .MB files, all textures , and word document.The compression pack is larger, mainly because the textures are too large.The earth's surface in different months are different in base color, and the angle of sunlight. Other textures, including white clouds, are the same.
Note: be sure to read the word instructions in the attachment first!
software  Maya 2015sp 6, MentalRay for Maya 2015sp 6, I install Maya 2015 and mentalRay first, then Maya sp 6 patch and mentalRay's sp 6 patch, or you can use a higher version.It is also possible to render with the Maya's own software render, but it is too slow and the effect is worse.
UVThe UV at the North and South poles has been optimized. There is absolutely no distortion of the textures at the North and South poles. Base Color 43200 * 21600Bump 43200 * 21600Specular 43200 * 21600NightLight 43200 * 21600Clouds 43200 * 21600Although the texture resolution is extremely high, but after optimization, there will be no delay after opening the file, the rendering process will be very smooth, there will never be a stuck or crashed situation, and the rendering quality of the textures will not be declined! 
I will post a partial rendering image. Please observe carefully.
One key adjustmentThe earth's material properties can be adjusted by one key, and only one attribute bar can be adjusted.For example: surface color, bump strength, sea/lake/river specular, color / transparency of white clouds, thickness / color of blue sky, etc. can be adjusted. I have written the specific adjustment method in a word file, in the compressed attachment.On the opposite side of the sun, the model will automatically appear night lights. The brightness of the lights, the color, and the speed of day and night switching can also be adjusted by one key. The method is also in the word file.
otherIn order to facilitate navigation, I have turned off the viewport to display the map. But for ease of location, I have drawn a set of mainland contour curves that you can locate based on.
copyrightThis model was done by me in my spare time, not for any company or any other person. If you buy my product, you can use it to make animations, movies, and games. But you can not resell, transfer or give the model in any way without my authorization.About the modelI believe that many people think that making a model of the earth is a simple job, but it is not. Low resolution earth is very easy to be done. However, to achieve the goal of ultra-high resolution and multi-functional adjustable, it is necessary to overcome too many technical difficulties. It is very difficult to achieve smooth navigation, smooth rendering. I personally collected a lot of information to study various solutions. I failed many times. I have now achieved the desired results and contributed the results to everyone.I hope you like it.

description_text:
NISAR is a cutting-edge Earth observation satellite jointly developed by NASA (United States) and ISRO (India). It is designed to provide high-resolution, all-weather, day-and-night imaging of Earth’s surface using advanced Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) technology operating in both L-band and S-band frequencies.
Primary Objectives:Monitor changes in Earth’s land and ice surfaces, including tectonic plate movement, landslides, and glacier dynamics.Study ecosystem changes, agricultural patterns, and natural resources.Track natural disasters like earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis to improve disaster response.Contribute to climate change research by analyzing biomass, soil moisture, and carbon cycle dynamics.
Key Features:Dual-frequency SAR (L-band by NASA, S-band by ISRO).High-resolution radar imaging capability through clouds and darkness.Large deployable radar antenna (~12 meters in diameter).747 km sun-synchronous orbit with a 12-day repeat cycle for global coverage.
Launch:Planned launch: 2024 (aboard GSLV Mk II from India).
Significance:NISAR is one of the most advanced Earth science missions, aimed at improving our understanding of Earth’s dynamic systems, enhancing resource management, and supporting disaster mitigation globally.

Dog Skeleton Rigged For Maya is a three-dimensional model of canine skeletal structure, representing the anatomical framework of a domestic dog.
Dog skeleton is the internal bone structure of a domestic dog that provides support, movement, and protection for organs. It is made up of skull, spine, ribs, and limb bones connected by joints. 
For canine anatomy 3D visualization, medical education, veterinary training, CGI, 3D animation, scientific illustration, and anatomical reference projects.
Dog Skeleton Rigged For Maya is a high quality, photo real 3d model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects. The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in Maya and rendered with V-Ray. Renders have no postprocessing!

description_text:
A bundle of 10 Cloud to Ground Lightnings, saving you $21 (19$ per model if bought separately).
These realistic Lightning 3D models are crafted to blend seamlessly in any kind of background environment and render very fast.
The mesh is optimized for low polycount and can also be used in games.
Total Polygons:72,599
Total Vertices:72,898
The Lightning geometry is made in real world scale ~ 8km height (which is the average height of this type of Cloud to Ground Lightning), but can be scaled up or down to fit your needs and will still look good in renders.Scene units - m (meters).
This is a V-Ray version.If you are using other renderer you will be able to use the geometry, but will have to make/use your own materials.
Every branch can be easily selected (by Element) in case you want to animate different illumination and/or timings per branch (as it happens in real world) for some spectacular slow motion animations.
All elements are UVW Unwrapped without overlapping just in case you need to use textures. Current one uses Vertex Color (which can be baked to texture if needed) and is embedded in the exported FBX format too (can be baked in Substance Designer, etc.).
Feel free to adjust the brightness of the light materials to best match your scene and camera settings. They are properly named and easy to set, separated by branch size.
The glow of the main bolt is made via V-Ray Lens effects Bloom + Glare (which is set up in the scene) and can be turned off if you want to add your own effects in post.
Rendered on black background the lightning will be perfect to blend in your image via 'Screen' or 'Lighten' mode in PhotoShop, AffiniPhoto, etc.
The geometry can also be used as a light source when merged in your scene. You can adjust only the main bolt strength as it is the brightest and most influential.
Make sure to check out a related V-Ray rendering tip included with this product as .jpg and .txt files.
Can be easily imported via drag and drop - there are no background objects, cameras and additional lights in the scene.
Compatible with 3dsMax 2010 and up.
Exported versions in 3DS, FBX and OBJ formats (no materials).
Please have in mind, that depending on the software you use, the exported formats may not look exactly how you see them in the preview images. In some cases the mesh may appear triangulated and you may need to manually reassign materials/textures .
If you feel like it, please use hashtag #lightning3d when you post online an image that uses this model, it will be fun for me to see.
Enjoy!

description_text:
3d model of the Central nervous system including cerebral cortex, gray matter, limbic system, basal ganglia , brainstem including midbrain pons, medulla, cranial nerves, cerebellum....all parts labelled in detail anatomically and precisely.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
Highly Detailed 3D scene of Red Blood Cells flowing inside a Blood Vessel.
Created in Maya 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. 
This scene is a highly detailed setup of red blood cells flowing inside a blood vessel. The walls of the blood vessel form a closed loop in which the blood cells travel through. An emitter at the beginning of the loop releases particles that flow along the curve of the vessel wall, which have been instanced with the blood cell polygonal geometry. The speed and amount of blood cells can be modified by adjusting the particle lifespan and rate attributes. 
The blood cells, camera and two lights flow along this 720 frame/30 second path. Once the camera and blood cells complete the loop they seamlessly repeat. Additional animated or stationary cameras and lights can be added anywhere inside the blood vessel walls. 
POLYGON COUNT:
For your convenience two scene files are included:-BloodVesselCACHED features particles that have been cached to complete only one loop.-BloodVesselUNCACHED features particles that will continue to emit for any desired amount of time.
These images have been rendered directly from the scene file, no post work is needed. 
This scene contains two lights that are animated along the camera path. Any additional lights and cameras can easily be added. 
Close attention to detail makes this scene ideal for use in medical animations, broadcast, print work, advertising, design visualization, personal projects, etc. 
Many other high quality models and scenes are available from this artist.

Centipedes (from Neo-Latin centi-, hundred, and Latin pes, pedis, foot) are predatory arthropods belonging to the class Chilopoda (Ancient Greek χεῖλος, kheilos, lip, and Neo-Latin suffix -poda, foot, describing the forcipules) of the subphylum Myriapoda, an arthropod group which includes millipedes and other multi-legged animals. Centipedes are elongated segmented (metameric) creatures with one pair of legs per body segment. All centipedes are venomous and can inflict painful stings, injecting their venom through pincer-like appendages known as forcipules or toxicognaths, which are actually modified legs instead of fangs. Despite the name, no species of centipede has exactly 100 legs; the number of pairs of legs is an odd number that ranges from 15 pairs to 191 pairs.[1]
Centipedes are predominantly generalist carnivorous, hunting for a variety of prey items that can be overpowered. They have a wide geographical range, which can be found in terrestrial habitats from tropical rainforests to deserts. Within these habitats, centipedes require a moist microhabitat because they lack the waxy cuticle of insects and arachnids, therefore causing them to rapidly lose water. Accordingly, they avoid direct sunlight by staying under cover or by being active at night.

description_text: Hip implants, or prostheses, are medical devices replacing a damaged hip joint, typically involving a metal stem with a ball for the thigh bone (femur) and a metal cup with a liner (plastic, ceramic) for the hip socket (acetabulum) to allow smooth movement, used in surgeries for pain relief from arthritis or injury, with various materials and fixation methods chosen by surgeons. ComponentsStem: A metal (often titanium) component inserted into the femur. Ball: A metal or ceramic ball that sits on the stem, replacing the femoral head. Cup: A metal cup (usually titanium) fixed into the pelvis. Liner: A plastic (polyethylene), ceramic, or metal liner inside the cup that allows the ball to glide smoothly. Types (Bearing Surfaces)Metal-on-Polyethylene: Metal ball with a plastic liner (common). Ceramic-on-Polyethylene: Ceramic ball with a plastic liner. Ceramic-on-Ceramic: Ceramic ball with a ceramic liner (very hard). Metal-on-Metal: Metal ball with a metal liner (less common now due to FDA concerns). Fixation MethodsCemented: Uses bone cement to fix the implant. Uncemented (Press-fit): The implant has a porous surface that bone grows into for fixation. Purpose & ProcedureReplaces a diseased or damaged hip joint, usually due to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, or fractures, relieving pain and restoring mobility.Can be a total hip replacement (both sides) or partial (just the ball). MaterialsCommonly uses biocompatible metals like titanium, cobalt-chromium alloys, and ceramics, chosen for strength and wear resistance.

description_text:
Bird Skeleton on Laboratory Stand is a three-dimensional model of complete avian bone structure mounted on a metal alligator clamp for educational and research purposes.
The model presents a detailed representation of bird anatomy, showing bones from the skull to the limbs. It allows clear observation of skeletal connections and proportions for scientific study.
For biology classrooms, zoology research, veterinary training, ornithology, museum displays, laboratory education, anatomical study, comparative anatomy, academic demonstrations, and scientific exhibitions.
Bird Skeleton on Laboratory Stand is a high quality, photo real 3d model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects. The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max and rendered with V-Ray. Renders have no postprocessing!
Hope you like it!
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, has real dimensions. Easy to merge into your scene.

  - Units: cm

  - The model was created with the optimal number of polygons. (The Meshsmooth modifier is assigned to the original mesh. Easy to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All the objects come with complete UVsAll textures and materials are included and mapped. (All colors can be easily modified.)

  - All objects are logically named and grouped for ease of objects selection and scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary (Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.) - just drop model into your scene.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - PBR Materials

  - 9 png (4096x4096)

description_text:
PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE YOU BUY!!!
everything you need to know about sci-fi modular corridor STANDARD EDITION:

  - STANDARD EDITION is simplified edition of my sci-fi modular corridor. It has lower price, simplier pieces of geometry and overall less polygons compared to Advanced Edition.

  - the modular corridor consists of three different parts: the door, corridor and the central part that can be combined with corridor or the door.

  - You can easily create infinite corridor variants using these three parts! (in preview images I show many different examples of that)

  - 1395256 polys and 1448860 vertices (3 modules in subdivision level 0). Keep in mind that the polycount number is only referred to one door + corridor + central module (everything else are instances/clones to extend it)

  - there is NO UW MAPPING or UNWRAPPED UVs

  - 95% of geometry are subdivision ready! Some parts are non subdiv ready because there's no need to subdivide them!

  - FBX and OBJ fles included (OBJ files have all the geometry in subdivision level 0) 

  - If you don't use MAX version, i strongly recommend you to use FBX file named extended_subdv + Instances. 

  - the preview screens are unedited made with Redshift and V-ray renderers

  - if you have any questions or special requests, don't hesitate to contact me!

description_text: The tibia, fibula, and talus are key bones in the ankle joint. The tibia (shin bone) and fibula (calf bone) are the bones of the lower leg that articulate with the talus (ankle bone), forming the ankle joint. This joint allows for plantarflexion (pointing the foot down) and dorsiflexion (pointing the foot up). The talus also articulates with the calcaneus (heel bone) to form the subtalar joint. This is the 3D model of the left tibia, fibula, and talus bone obtained from the CT scan data of a healthy female patient. This model contains cortical bone as well as cancellous bone. it can be used for finite element analysis on various finite element software such as Ansys, Catia, Solidworks, Creo, etc. The model can also be used for 3D printing as well, as it contains stl and obj files. The 3D solid model files contain igs, stp, obj, stl, catpart and catproduct  files under a compressed zip folder.

description_text:
The pancreas in diabetes shows microscopical changes as depicted in this model. The detailed anatomy of pancreas including exocrine glandular and ductal flow of exocrine pancreatic and biliary secretion is outlined with labels.The endocrine pancreas (islets) with its cell type ( alpha, beta, F cell and delta cell) and its secretions (glucagon, insulin, Pancreatic polypeptide and somatostatin respectively) is shown with labels. These are compared side by side for a normal and diabetic islets.The blender file has most of the modifiers applied except the particle modifier for lymphocyte. The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

Types of 3D Models: There are various types of 3D models, including wireframe models, solid models, surface models, and polygonal models. Each type serves different purposes based on the level of detail required and the intended application.
Applications: 3D models find applications in various industries, such as video games, animation, architecture, product design, virtual reality, augmented reality, medical visualization, and engineering simulations.
Creation Process: 3D models can be created using different techniques, including 3D sculpting, polygonal modeling, NURBS modeling, and CAD (Computer-Aided Design) software. These tools allow artists and designers to craft detailed and realistic virtual objects.
Textures and Materials: 3D models can have textures applied to their surfaces, giving them realistic appearances. Materials can be defined to simulate how light interacts with different surfaces, adding to the model's visual realism.
Rigging and Animation: In certain cases, 3D models can be rigged with a virtual skeleton to enable animation. Animators can then manipulate the model's movements for use in games, films, or other interactive media.
File Formats: 3D models are typically saved in specific file formats like .obj, .fbx, .stl, .blend, and more, which allow them to be imported and used in different 3D software or game engines.
Complexity and Polygons: The complexity of a 3D model is often measured by the number of polygons used to create it. Higher polygon counts result in more detailed and smoother models, but they can also be more resource-intensive.
Rendering: The process of generating 2D images from 3D models is known as rendering. Advanced rendering techniques can create photorealistic images with lifelike lighting, shadows, and reflections.
3D Printing: 3D models can be converted into physical objects using 3D printing technology, enabling rapid prototyping and manufacturing of various products.
Asset Marketplaces: There are online marketplaces where artists and designers can sell or purchase 3D models, making it a thriving ecosystem for content creators and developers.
Overall, 3D models play a crucial role in modern digital media and have opened up new possibilities for visualization, entertainment, design, and innovation.

A detailed 3D section of the human kidney showing the internal anatomy with defined renal pyramids, calyces, the ureter origin, and indicated arterial and venous structures. The cut geometry follows real anatomical layering, giving a clean and readable interior form. This model is designed for CG animation, architectural visualization, game development, and general educational or illustrative purposes.
Key Features

  - 
Detailed internal kidney section (pyramids, calyces, ureter origin)

  - Anatomically accurate internal layout and proportions

  - 
Clean topology and optimized mesh

  - High-quality  4K PBR textures (Diffuse, Roughness, Normal)

  - 
Ready to render out-of-the-box with included lights and cameras

  - Native Blender setup – no third-party plug-ins required 

Technical Details

  - 
Original Software: Blender v3.4

  - 
Tested in: Blender 4.5 (Fully compatible) 

  - 
Objects Included: 1

  - 
Polygons: 2,664 (Subdivision OFF) / 42,512 (Subdivision ON)

  - 
Vertices: 2,674 (Subdivision OFF) / 42,536 (Subdivision ON)

  - 
Units: Centimeters (H: 12, W: 4, L: 8)

  - 
Renderer: Blender Cycles 

  - 
Plug-ins: None required

Textures & Materials

  - Standard PBR workflow

  - 
4K textures (4096×4096 px): Diffuse, Roughness, Normal

  - All textures created from original photographs or drawings

  - 
Ready to render out-of-the-box – lighting and cameras used for previews are included

Mesh & File Structure

  - 
Handcrafted mesh with clean topology

  - Export formats (non-native) provided as base mesh (not smoothed) for flexible subdivision control

Additional Notes

  - All preview renders created in Blender Cycles without compositing editors

  - Please note that this product is not a certified medical device, scientific reference material, or diagnostic tool

description_text:
Servoid, the futuristic servant android. Needs neither breaks, toilet visits nor tips. Based on a hypothetical actuator technology called Hyperconductive Wave Displacement Surfaces, based on high-tensile electromagnet grids built upon MEMS technologies. Which means that an android losing 100% of power will fall apart into his constituent pieces.

A Unity 3D v3 package is included with custom shaders, see 3D preview demo:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B5Sa4V0tIqRveWh3VkJQNTIxRGM/edit?usp=sharing
The specific Max file used for the Unity version will be lying in the Assets library on install.

Model is specifically built for meshsmoothing.
Layered PSDs included, where colors, markings and level of rust&dust can be easily changed.
Everything is UV-unwrapped. Main textures are 5 1024x1024 TGAs for the separate limbs. This gives more memory economy, if making a new texture for some specific limb.

Using basic Max materials & HDRI reflection, tailored for realtime graphics. All images were rendered in scanline mode.

The bottle, tray & glasses are included in the scene.
FBX file comes with reduced material functionality. OBJ file has no materials.

Design and concept by the artist.

3D Studio Max 9 file.

description_text:
Greetings! Have you ever wanted to explore the intricate world of congenital heart diseases? Our 3D model of a heart with congenital heart diseases is the perfect way to do just that. Congenital heart disease refers to any structural abnormality of the heart that is present at birth, and affects approximately 1 in every 100 babies born. These defects can range from simple to complex, and can cause a wide variety of symptoms. Our highly-detailed 3D model allows you to visualize and understand the complex anatomy of congenital heart diseases in a way that traditional textbooks simply cannot match. With the ability to 3D model and print the heart, you can hold a physical representation of the defect and study it in detail. This model is perfect for medical students, doctors, or anyone with an interest in cardiology. So why settle for a 2D image when you can hold a physical model of a congenital heart disease in your hands? Buy our 3D model today and gain a deeper understanding of these fascinating conditions.
With this Congenital Heart disease Pack you will get 7 different 3D models.
This Congenital Heart Disease Pack includes:

  - Atrial Septal Defect (ASD)

  - Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD)

  - Bicuspid Aortic Valve (BAV)

  - Common arterial trunk (CAT)

  - Partial Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Connection (PAPVC)

  - Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF)

  - Transposition of the Great Arteries (TOGA)

Surface Spikes: Detailed gp120/gp41 complexes.

Photorealistic Animated Earth with Aurora, Clouds & Atmosphere - render-ready in Cinema 4D with ultra-high 43K textures.
This is a fully detailed, animated 3D Earth with realistic clouds, a layered atmosphere, separate day and night surfaces, and a dynamic aurora system: 6 northern and 6 southern aurora flare types that shift in appearance as the planet rotates. Built and lit entirely with default Cinema 4D render settings, it opens and renders out of the box - no scene setup needed.

  - 4 geospheres with adjustable polygon count (set the resolution yourself)

  - Separate layers: Earth, Clouds, Atmosphere (multiple), Night Fog, Sunset, Aurora

  - Aurora system: North (types 1-6) and South (types 1-6)

  - Lights controller: night sky lights (white / green / blue) and night map background lights (white / red)

  - Compatible with Cinema 4D 2011 and later

Recommended hardware

  - 16 GB RAM or more (an extra 32 GB swap helps)

  - At least 2 GB video memory

  - ~30 GB free disk space; an SSD is strongly recommended

  - First load can take up to ~5 minutes while the high-resolution textures load

description_text:
A completely labelled detailed model of male genito-urinary tract.The blend file is in zip form along with textures for the UV maps of the different organ system.The blend file has unapplied subdivision surface modifier.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
The blend model (scale 1:1) has bones of skull seperable from each other and each of the bone is labelled with its name and its parts. Each bone with its labels is a single mesh making it easy to seperate the individual bone along with its labels for easy study.The internal structure of the cranium as well as the base of skull is labelled with all of the foramen accurate and precise anatomicallyThe material has diffuse and normal image textures with non overlapping UVs. Most of the bones have separate image texture for each of the bone.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
I got frustrated by the helical focuser on this telescope so I decided to replace the entire secondary mirror holder (spider) assembly with one which will accept a rack focuser which is readily available.  The quality of observations is unchanged, but the usability is much improved - it is now a joy to use the scope and much less of a pain to change between non-parafocal eyepieces! 
ADDITIONAL HARDWARE REQUIRED:

  - 3x M4 nuts (required to retain secondary mirror)

  - 4x M4 x 10mm long screws with a countersunk head (or equivalent, to attach rack focusser)This model also uses a minimum of additional hardware, only needing 3x M4 nuts to suit the grub screws for adjusting the secondary mirror, and the 4 screws or nuts and bolts to hold in the new focusser of your chosing. In my case I used M4 x 10mm long screws with a countersunk head, but any bolt or nut combo under 3.5mm in diameter will work without modification.

Notes:

  - This design helps block stray light and provides a backing for the secondary.

  - When closed, it increases the length of the optical tube to about 50cm. 

  - I have not experienced any balance issues even with heavy eyepieces. 

  - The minimum focus distance is maintained compared to the original. T

  - his mount also incorporates an upgrade to a standard finder scope shoe to enable the use of standard accessories (not only the red-dot finder. 

  - This model is designed to be 3D printed without supports. 

  - I have designed a matching lid, since the original does not seat fully due to the new design - a worthy sacrifices to improve printability!

Designed to fit:

  - Sky-Watcher VIRTUOSO GTi 150/750mm Reflector dobsonian 

  - Sky-Watcher Heritage 6″ Collapsible Tabletop Telescope (non-GTi) 

Example rack focusser which will fit: https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/365245336938

This amphibian lacks the typical dark pigmentation seen in other axolotls, resulting in a pale or pinkish hue. Additionally, it lacks external gills, a characteristic feature of its species. description_text:
Neurons-fly-through visualization package:
This package contains an animated 3ds max project and accompanying After effects project files. The 3ds max file contains a large neural network environment and includes animated omni-lights to simulate neural synapses (see Vimeovideo on top). It also includes an environment map and library of shaders to make different kinds of render outputs possible.
The project file is setup with all necessary render elements, output formats and directory inputs. The render elements are combined in an After Effects project file (included and setup).
Note: For sake of data amount the render elements are not included in this package but the fist frames of every pass are, so one can use the After Effects file to see the result and fiddle around with variables. In this way one can determine which passes he wants to use to get his desired result and needs only those passes rendered out.
This combination provides a complete setup to create different kinds of animations and looks. (camera in 3ds max file is animated over a nurbs curve which can be altered easily) It is no problem to add secondary animation ore objects (for instance like nanobots,virus, etc.) You can simulate electron microscopy effects, Jelly like shading, or something out of this world.(see example renders on top) The After Effects files provides additional options to alter the look of the project. For instance, one can change lighting and shading conditions in near real-time, including refraction and reflections. This is done through a plug-in which is able to make use of Zbuffer and normal information to perform shading functions inside After Effects. The plugin is called Normality and is developed by Stefan Minning. You can download the After Effects plugin for free on his website.(http://www.3dcg.net/software/normality/
All techniques and explanation on how to work with this project are described in a detailed PDF guide included in this package.
Also delivered with this package is an 11 seconds Full HD output Quicktime movie,low compression for maximum quality (see Vimeo sample). The animation begins in the middle of traveling through a neural network and stops by entering a neuron. It can be used as an in-between for interior visualization of a neuron.
Ps. you need to have Frischluft Lenscare, Video copilot Optical flares, Normality and Magic bullet Looks (After Effects plugins) to make the After Effects files work. Al web links to plugins are included in the PDF guide.
Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the small envelope icon next to the Author name or enter his profile and use the green contact button on the left).
Have fun,

description_text:
3D model of artistic interpretation of cancer cells. Ideal for medical visualization or environment designs and VR applications.
Model has 4 separate parts, Cytoplasm, cells, nucleuses and speckles. Al models are polygonal (mostly quad based) and Sub D ready.
Most renders on top are made with the provided 3ds max 2016 file using Octane render plugin. All shaders used (17 total) are included in the file and provide different options to determine visual style.
Note: the renders on top are optimized in photoshop, the file does not produce these renders out of the box, file is setup to produce images with alpha channel, background needs to be added afterwards.
This package contains following items: - One 3ds max file setup with Octane render plug-in (you need the plug-in in order to use this file properly) - One 3ds max file setup with basic native scanline shaders (includes light rig and renders basic images out of the box) - One FBX file for import of the 3D models in all major 3D packages (no shaders). - One OBJ file for import of the 3D models in all major 3D packages (also no shaders). - One Marmoset Toolbag file renders out of the box (the white orange images you see on top) (this file provide real-time PBR previewing and includes some basic shaders) - One spherical HDR image, bright transparent organic looking environment, 3500x1400 pixels - One spherical HDR image, darker metallic looking environment, 3500x1400 pixels.

An atomic veteran is a veteran who was exposed to ionizing radiation while present in the site of a nuclear explosion during active duty. The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs defines an atomic veteran who, as part of his or her military service: Participated in an above-ground nuclear test, 1945–1962; or was part of the U.S. military occupation forces in/around Hiroshima/Nagasaki before 1946; or was held as a POW in or near Hiroshima or Nagasaki (certain cases).
Atomic veterans also include service personnel from other nations, including the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, France, China, and Russia, who were similarly exposed during their active service.A formal investigation of the radiation exposure these veterans received, as well as radiation experiments conducted on humans, was initiated in 1994 by former President Bill Clinton, who apologized for their treatment in 1995. In 1996, the U.S. Congress repealed the Nuclear Radiation Secrecy Agreement Act, which rescinded the Atomic Veteranoath-of-secrecy,thus allowing Atomic-Veterans the opportunity to recount stories of their participation in nuclear weapon testing and post-test event activities, without legal penalty. By this time, however, many thousands of Atomic Veterans, the majority of whom were afflicted with a host of radiation-induced health issues, such as cancer, had taken thatsecret"with them to their graves

description_text:
Do you find creating realistic materials too hard and time consuming? Do you wish to have a huge material library that will save you time while shading and texturing your models? If yes then your problems are solved cause Vmats is here for you.
Vmats is a realistic and high quality material library for Blender. It comes with lots of materials for Cycles and Eevee.
Vmats for Cycles has 1819 materials, Vmats for Eevee has 1755 materials, total 3574 materials.
Vmats comes with an easily understandable interface to make browsing, previewing and assigning of the various material categories easy and fast.
Vmats materials have been optimized for fast renders while maintaining high quality.
All available materials have their unique parameters for easy identification and also you can easily customise a material.
With Vmats you can leaving to focus on the more important parts of your project.

VMATS 1.6.0 and VSHADE 1.8.2 released...

Vshade works under Blender 2.83, 2.90, 2.91, 2.92, 2.93, 3.0, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.0, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 5.0 and newer versions. Vshade will update for new Blender versions.

When you purchase VMATS, VSHADE comes for free. ( https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/scripts-plugins/rendering/vshade-professional-shader-system-for-blender )

For view high resolution catalogue, please download VMATS Documentation pdf.

VMATS FOR CYCLES:

  - The library of the superior quality materials for Cycles.

  - 1819 Material

VMATS FOR EEVEE:

  - The library of the superior quality materials for Eevee.

  - 1755 Material

MAIN CATEGORIES

  - 
Car Paint (71 + 71 materials), Ceramic (93 + 93 materials), Concrete (30 + 30 materials)

Fabric: Canvas, Denim, Knitting, Linen, Silk, Terry, Tweed-Damask, Velvet (303 + 303 materials)

Food (20 + 21 materials), Gemstone (39 materials), Glass (48 + 28 materials)

  - 
Interior Paint (224 + 224 materials), Leather (42 + 42 materials), Liquid (104 + 104 materials)

  - 
Metal (178 + 177 materials), Pearl (14 + 14 materials), Plastic (38 + 38 materials), Rug (28 + 28 materials)

  - 
Stones: Agate, Granite, Marble, Onyx, Quartzite, Travertine, Various (125 + 125 materials)

  - 
Stucco-Plaster (66 + 66 materials), Suede (28 + 28 materials), Tiles (62 + 62 materials)

  - 
Weave (11 + 11 materials), Wood (252 + 252 materials), Various (43 + 38 materials)

Vmats KEY FEATURES

  - 
Realistic,  Easy to use,  Clear interface,  Highly customizable

  - Well documented,  Well organized,  ASSET MANAGER,  Integrated directly in Blender

  - 
Seamless Textures,  2K to 4K Textures,  Mostly Physically Correct

  - Works with ASSET BROWSER

Vshade KEY FEATURES

  - 
Easy to use,  All in one,  Clear interface,  Well documented

  - Example scenes,  PBR Ready (supports METALLIC and SPECULAR workflows)

  - 
Integrated directly in Blender,  Totally Linear Workflow,  ANISOTROPIC SHADER FOR EEVEE

  - PARALLAX OCCLUSION MAP (POM),  Realistic and Physically Correct ABSORPTION

  - Realistic and Continious DISPERSION*,  Realistic Refraction,  **MICRO ROUGHNESS*

  - Roughness based PHYSICALLY CORRECT FRESNEL,  Separated Refraction and Reflection

  - 
CONDUCTIVE FRESNEL (for metals),  Limitable Per Material Bounce (MAX DEPTH) and Exit Color

  - 
Metalness and Edge Tint support,  THIN FILM (INTERFERENCE) node

  - CUSTOM SHADOW and Affect Shadow,  FAKE CAUSTICS,  EFFECT nodes

  - Realistic SKIN node,  Realistic HAIR node,  Realistic CAR PAINT node

  - Realistic VOLUMETRIC node,  Realistic FLAME node, NORMAL COMBINER

  - 
NORMAL MAP MERGER,  33 HQ PROCEDURAL TEXTURE NODES

  - Custom Transparent,  TWO SIDED nodes,  Seamless Texture Animation

  - 
EDGE DETECTION nodes,  DIRT, GRUNGE and SCRATCH nodes

  - Multiple Blend nodes,  Color Levels nodes,  Special nodes

  - Custom Gradient nodes,  Falloff nodes,  Color nodes

  - 
Math nodes,  Vector Math nodes,  Logic Nodes (IF),  Vector Transform nodes

PLUS

IOR List Table,  Reflection Roughness Table,  Refraction Roughness Table

description_text:
Accurate very high definition skin section model including hairs, hair roots, sebaceous glands, perspiratory glands, receptors, nerves and blood vessels. The model has a high resolution texture map with a resolution of 4096 x 4096 pixel size applied.  To get an even higher level of detail normal bump and displacement bump maps with a resolution of 2048 x 2048 pixel are included. In the 3dsMax version the bump maps are already applied in the other version they need to be assigned to the model.
Most parts of the model have been created as SubDivision/Meshsmooth surface. This means using the 3dSMax version you can change the resolution/smoothness of the SubDivision/Meshsmooth surfaces very easy. If you import the lowest resolution of the .obj, .fbx or .lwo version into a 3D Software that supports SubDivision surfaces, you can also change the resolution/smoothness of the SubDivision/Meshsmooth surfaces very easy. The base version of the model which is not smoothed has a polycount of 58756 polygons.
For other software packages that do not support SubDivision surfaces the model is available in 3 different resolutions ranging from 56012 to 766368 polygons.
Max 2010 Format:Meshsmooth is applied so you can set the resolution of the SubDivision/Meshsmooth surfaces as you like.
Maya 2008 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Maya 2013 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
FBX Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Cinema 4D 9.6 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Lwo 6.0 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions. 
Obj Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions. 
3ds Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Previews rendered in 3dsMax using VRay. Please note that the VRay materials and light settings are not included.

description_text:
The model details, with labels, the end regions of a growing long bone, a process called enchondral ossification. The two parts of the end of a long bone i.e. metaphysis and epiphysis are further detailed in subparts including the cross section and internal anatomy and histology including vascular flow.The blend file has three separate meshes i.e. front half, back half and blood vessels.Materials include both image and procedural textures with two different overlapping UV maps.Good model for teaching human bone anatomy and histology.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
Starter pack of 5 Cloud to Ground Lightnings - $6 bundle savings.
These realistic Lightning 3D models are crafted to blend seamlessly in any kind of background environment and render very fast.
The mesh is optimized for low polycount and can also be used in games.
Total Polygons:41,106
Total Vertices:41,281
The Lightning geometry is made in real world scale ~ 8km height (which is the average height of this type of Cloud to Ground Lightning), but can be scaled up or down to fit your needs and will still look good in renders.Scene units - m (meters).
This is a V-Ray version.If you are using other renderer you will be able to use the geometry, but will have to make/use your own materials.
Every branch can be easily selected (by Element) in case you want to animate different illumination and/or timings per branch (as it happens in real world) for some spectacular slow motion animations.
All elements are UVW Unwrapped without overlapping just in case you need to use textures. Current one uses Vertex Color (which can be baked to texture if needed) and is embedded in the exported FBX format too (can be baked in Substance Designer, etc.).
Feel free to adjust the brightness of the light materials to best match your scene and camera settings. They are properly named and easy to set, separated by branch size.
The glow of the main bolt is made via V-Ray Lens effects Bloom + Glare (which is set up in the scene) and can be turned off if you want to add your own effects in post.
Rendered on black background the lightning will be perfect to blend in your image via 'Screen' or 'Lighten' mode in PhotoShop, AffiniPhoto, etc.
The geometry can also be used as a light source when merged in your scene. You can adjust only the main bolt strength as it is the brightest and most influential.
Make sure to check out a related V-Ray rendering tip included with this product as .jpg and .txt files.
Can be easily imported via drag and drop - there are no background objects, cameras and additional lights in the scene.
Compatible with 3dsMax 2010 and up.
Exported versions in 3DS, FBX and OBJ formats (no materials).
Please have in mind, that depending on the software you use, the exported formats may not look exactly how you see them in the preview images. In some cases the mesh may appear triangulated and you may need to manually reassign materials/textures .
If you feel like it, please use hashtag #lightning3d when you post online an image that uses this model, it will be fun for me to see.
Enjoy!

For astronomy education, astrophysics research, space science visualization, planetarium projection, scientific presentations, and immersive universe exploration.

description_text:
This is a 3D simulation that illustrates an axial plane view into
 one of the layers of the Cerebral cortex, containing pyramidal neurons.  
The scene is build up of a large set of instanced 3D subdivided models (center region)
in combination with cylindrical billboard opacity mapped neurons (outside region).
There's al large degree of freedom of movement within this scene.
Make al sort of flythrough situations ore zoom close-up shots.
Currently there's an animated camera on a circular path.  
The package contains following items:  

  - A 3ds max file setup with Vray renderer containing a vast neural network environment
consisting of 187 variations of instanced 3D models of 5 different neuron models.
also includes shaders (electron microscopy effect), billboards, animated camera and
texture environment.

  - A 3ds max file setup with native scanline renderer consisting of same scene but
normals inverted for interior rendering of the neurons.

  - A 3ds max file setup with native scanline renderer containing the 5 unique neuron models.

  - An export OBJ file containing the 5 unique neuron models for import to all other major
3d applications. (geometry only)

  - An export OBJ file containing the neural network for import to all other major
3d applications. (geometry only)

  - An After Effects file that combines the render outputs and provides all settings to
alter the final look.

  - A map with some hi-res final renders

  - 3 textures and 6 billboard renders

  - A PDF with some instructions on how to use the project. 

Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the small envelope icon next to the Author name or enter his profile and use the green contact button on the left).
Have fun,

description_text:
Dinosaur skeletons are crucial for understanding the physical characteristics, behaviors, and evolutionary relationships of different species of dinosaurs. They provide insights into how dinosaurs moved, ate, and evolved, and help us reconstruct their evolutionary history.Dinosaur fossils have several uses, including scientific research, education, museum exhibits, economic value, and conservation.Based on popularity and cultural significance, I have designed some 3D model of the top favorite dinosaurs include:

  - 
Tyrannosaurus Rex: Known for its powerful jaws and enormous size, this carnivorous dinosaur is one of the most well-known and popular dinosaurs.

  - 
Stegosaurus: With its distinctive bony plates and spiked tail, this herbivorous dinosaur is a favorite among dinosaur enthusiasts of all ages.

  - 
Triceratops: Another herbivorous dinosaur, this creature is known for its distinctive three-horned skull and frilled neck.

  - 
Velociraptor: Although much smaller than its movie counterpart, the Velociraptor was still a fierce predator with sharp teeth and claws.

  - 
Brachiosaurus: This dinosaur is famous for its incredibly long neck, which allowed it to reach vegetation high above the ground.

  - ....

Dinosaurs have fascinated people for centuries, with their enormous size, fearsome appearance, and mysterious disappearance from the planet. One of the most enduring and intriguing aspects of dinosaurs is their skeleton bones, which have provided scientists with valuable insights into the anatomy, behavior, and evolution of these prehistoric creatures.
Dinosaur skeleton bones are among the most prized fossils in the world, with specimens ranging from tiny fragments to complete skeletons measuring up to 100 feet long. These bones have been found all over the world, from the deserts of the American West to the mountains of China, and they have helped to shed light on the amazing diversity of the dinosaur kingdom.
Studying dinosaur bones has allowed scientists to reconstruct the skeletons of these ancient animals and to gain a better understanding of how they moved, ate, and interacted with their environment. By analyzing the shapes and sizes of different bones, scientists can infer details about the dinosaur's muscles, organs, and other soft tissues, as well as its overall size and shape.
Despite the challenges of studying fossils that are millions of years old, scientists continue to make new discoveries about dinosaurs and their bones, expanding our understanding of these fascinating creatures and the world they inhabited.

description_text:
3d model of respiratory tract with separate object of larynx trachea and lungs with lobes..The textures are overlapping for trachea and lungs.the lungs are water tight. the blend file has unapplied subdivisions. the images shown are at subdivision 0.the zip files are having textures as well.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.
